test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who has been appointed as Secretary to President Droupadi Murmu in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Rajesh Verma.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Odisha cadre IAS officer Rajesh Verma has been appointed as the Secretary to President Droupadi Murmu.
 
• He replaces the incumbent Kapil Dev Tripathi, a 1980-batch IAS officer.
 
• Verma is currently serving as Secretary, Ministry of Corporate Affairs & has also served as principal secretary to Odisha CM Naveen Patnaik.
 
• Droupadi Murmu took oath as the 15th President of India on 25 July 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important Appointments:

 
 
• Sanjay Arora, director general of the ITBP and a 1988-batch IPS officer, has been appointed as the new Delhi Police Commissioner.
 
• IFS officer of the 1994 batch Pranay Kumar Verma has been appointed as India’s next High Commissioner to Bangladesh.
 
• Govt of Bangladesh has appointed Mustafizur Rahman as the next High Commissioner of Bangladesh to India.
 
• The Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) panel has appointed Brajesh Kumar Upadhyay as Chairman and managing Director (CMD) of Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL).
 
• Shri **B.V.R. Subrahmanyam **joined as C**hief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog on 25.02.2023.** An Indian Administrative Service Officer of the **1987 batch (Chhattisgarh).**
 
• New Development Bank (NDB) of the BRICS countries has appointed Dr D J Pandian as the Director-General of its India Regional Office in Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City).
 
• Senior Diplomat Ruchira Kamboj has been appointed as the Ambassador and Permanent Representative of India to the United Nations.
